title: Saturday notes, 3 October 2026
dek: Ten products for Saturday, 3 October 2026. Stripe verified every figure. You can open the source from the note.

companies.name: Kibu
companies.description: Content, compliance, and EHR platform built specifically for provider organizations serving people with intellectual and developmental disabilities (I/DD). Helps DSPs deliver care while managing regulatory documentation across hundreds of orgs and ~48 US states. HIPAA-compliant; contact-sales pricing. Founded Jan 2022, US.
companies.evidence: ~$234,319 MRR, 375 active subscriptions, ~$200,210 L30 snapshot, ~$3,096,047 all-time. Founded Jan 2022, US. Caveat: Stripe API key expired; revenue last synced Apr 19, 2026 (profile still shows cached L30/MRR snapshots). Last profile refresh cached around Oct 4, 2026 UTC.
companies.indieAngle: Pick one regulated care vertical (I/DD, home health, behavioral health) in one country and own documentation + compliance + scheduling. Sell to ops directors, not founders on X.
companies.whyItPrints: Pure regulated vertical ops software — the Conductor shape applied to disability services. Providers cannot improvise compliance; once the EHR + care logs live in Kibu, switching costs explode. High ACV B2B seats (375 subs → ~$234k MRR) without consumer virality.

companies.name: UK hormone prescribing + ops agency
companies.description: Stealth TrustMRR listing described as a Hormone Prescribing service in UK & Operations/Automation Consulting Agency. No public domain on TrustMRR. GB, founded Mar 2023, bootstrapped. 2,339 active subscriptions on Stripe.
companies.evidence: ~$165,463 MRR, 2,339 active subscriptions, ~$240,175–$240,376 L30, ~$6,414,562 all-time, ~60% L30 profit margin. Last sync Oct 3, 2026 ~05:24 Warsaw (03:24 UTC).
companies.indieAngle: Pair a licensed niche (hormones, dermatology, dental, vet) with productized ops/automation for clinics. Compliance is the moat; software is the leverage.
companies.imageAlt: UK hormone prescribing + ops agency product image
companies.whyItPrints: Regulated medical + ops consulting hybrid: recurring patient/service revenue under UK prescribing rules, plus agency automation. Massive all-time (~$6.4M) with real seat count — classic "own a regulated workflow, charge monthly" print, not a toy GPT wrapper.

companies.name: 1Lookup
companies.description: Real-time phone, email, and IP validation/enrichment API — 34 data products on one API key and one shared credit balance (validation, enrichment, B2B prospecting, SEO, transcription). Usage/credit pricing; integrations with Twilio, HubSpot, Shopify, Salesforce. Founded Jan 2022, US. Listed for sale at $10M on TrustMRR.
companies.evidence: ~$247,963 MRR, 686 active subscriptions, ~$389,388–$389,883 L30, ~$5,201,760 all-time, ~40% L30 profit margin. Last sync Oct 3, 2026 ~04:09 Warsaw (02:09 UTC).
companies.indieAngle: Ship one boring verification/enrichment API (phone, VAT ID, IBAN, company registry) with prepaid credits. Own the "stop paying for bad data" wedge.
companies.whyItPrints: Developer infra plumbing that fraud teams and marketers renew without thinking. Credits > seats: L30 revenue (~$390k) exceeds listed MRR (~$248k) because of overage/usage. Unsexy data quality that invoices itself.

companies.name: Rezi
companies.description: AI-assisted resume builder aimed at ATS-friendly job applications. Free / Pro ~$29/mo / Lifetime ~$149; Rezi Enterprise for orgs (300+ organizations claimed). Forbes-ranked #1 AI resume builder (company-stated). Founded May 2015, US, VC-backed. ~4.5M estimated users on TrustMRR.
companies.evidence: ~$251,264 MRR, 10,418 active subscriptions, ~$222,910–$224,316 L30, ~$10,260,842 all-time, ~60% L30 profit margin. Last sync Oct 3, 2026 ~04:15 Warsaw (02:15 UTC).
companies.indieAngle: Own one career-bureaucracy artifact (resume, cover letter, visa packet, LinkedIn audit) with freemium + lifetime + enterprise upsell. Volume seats print even at low ARPU.
companies.whyItPrints: Job-hunt utility with brutal volume — 10k+ paying subs and $10M+ all-time. "Make my PDF pass the ATS" is evergreen career bureaucracy glue, not a novelty chat app.

companies.name: Cometly
companies.description: Marketing attribution and analytics for B2B SaaS — sends accurate attribution data back to ad platforms; AI chat over ads data. Founded Oct  mid-2020, US. High ACV (291 subs → ~$206k MRR).
companies.evidence: ~$206,311 MRR, 291 active subscriptions, ~$253,748 L30, ~$9,929,042 all-time, ~90% L30 profit margin. Last sync Oct 3, 2026 ~04:13 Warsaw (02:13 UTC).
companies.indieAngle: Narrow attribution for one channel stack (Meta+Stripe, or LinkedIn+HubSpot) and charge for "which ad paid the invoice." High ACV, small logo count.
companies.whyItPrints: Ads attribution plumbing. SaaS teams pay to know which campaigns closed revenue; once pixels and CRM sync live, churn is painful. Analytics infra with fat seats, not consumer virality.

companies.name: Probate leads
companies.description: Stealth TrustMRR listing: sells probate leads to real estate investors and agents. Pulls motivated sellers who must sell within ~90–120 days due to legal situations; works directly with courts; enrichment pipeline claimed. Pricing: $1 trial, then ~$50–$800/mo tiers. TALL stack (Tailwind/Alpine/Laravel/Livewire). Founded Mar 2010, US. ~800 estimated users, 627 active subs.
companies.evidence: ~$71,149 MRR, 627 active subscriptions, ~$62,295–$62,658 L30, ~$972,190 all-time, ~75% L30 profit margin. Last sync Oct 3, 2026 ~07:08 Warsaw (05:08 UTC).
companies.indieAngle: Own one courthouse/public-record niche (probate, tax liens, code violations, liquor licenses) and sell enriched leads on a subscription. Bureaucracy is the data moat.
companies.whyItPrints: Court → lead → investor data glue. Zero AI-demo energy: scrape/enrich probate filings, charge subscriptions for inventory. Sticky because lead quality compounds with court relationships.

TrustMRR description mixes "CRM and Lead generation softwares" with outbound services. Founded Mar 2023, US. ~200 estimated users, 289 active subs.
companies.evidence: ~$100,269 MRR, 289 active subscriptions, ~$84,224 L30, ~$768,741 all-time. Last sync Oct 3, 2026 ~06:04 Warsaw (04:04 UTC).

companies.whyItPrints: Productized outbound + CRM seats. High MRR on a few hundred customers means real ACV. Selling "we book meetings" as recurring software/services hybrid — classic indie MSP-adjacent print.

companies.name: CartBoss
companies.description: Pay-as-you-go SMS abandoned-cart recovery for Shopify/WooCommerce stores. No monthly subscription; first 25 messages free; GDPR-compliant. Founded Mar 2021, Slovenia.
companies.evidence: MRR $0 / 0 seat subscriptions (usage-based), ~$25,822–$25,974 L30, ~$1,741,653 all-time, ~45% L30 profit margin. Last sync Oct 3, 2026 ~05:00 Warsaw (03:00 UTC).
companies.indieAngle: Own one recovery channel for a platform (Shopify SMS, WhatsApp, email dunning) with prepaid credits. Charge for messages sent, not seats.
companies.whyItPrints: E-com revenue plumbing — SMS "you left something in your cart." Usage billing means no seat MRR, but ~$1.74M all-time proves the meter prints when stores send volume. Classic boring recovery infra.

companies.name: PROCLINICA

Proclinica Pro ~€34.99/mo or ~€367.20/year, 7-day trial. Founded Aug 2021, Spain. ~350 estimated users, 136 active subs.
companies.evidence: ~$4,416 MRR, 136 active subscriptions, ~$6,726 L30, ~$35,464 all-time, ~80% L30 profit margin. Last sync Oct 3, 2026 ~06:51 Warsaw (04:51 UTC).
companies.indieAngle: Build clinic/practice software for one EU country with local e-invoice + privacy baked in. Sell in the local language; compliance beats features.
companies.whyItPrints: Country clinic OS — Calendesk/Khosmos cousin for private healthcare. Local e-invoicing (VeriFactu) and privacy law are the moat; solo clinics pay to avoid Excel + WhatsApp chaos.

companies.name: White Glove Content
companies.description: Subscription productized service that produces faceless social video (scripting, AI voiceover, editing, thumbnails) for YouTube/TikTok/Reels/Facebook, delivered via dashboard with optional auto-upload. Starter ~$54 / Growth ~$124 / Pro ~$284 per month; month-to-month, $0 setup. Bootstrapped, team 2–5, founded Apr 2026, US. Listed for sale at $2.5M on TrustMRR.
companies.evidence: ~$66,171 MRR, 589 active subscriptions, ~$69,308–$69,382 L30, ~$242,825 all-time, ~65% L30 profit margin. Last sync Oct 3, 2026 ~08:31 Warsaw (06:31 UTC).
companies.indieAngle: Productize one creative ops pipeline (faceless video, newsletter, product photos) into fixed monthly tiers with a client dashboard. Sell the outcome, meter the seats.
companies.whyItPrints: Done-for-you content factory sold as SaaS seats. 589 subs × mid-tier ARPU = real print without building another UGC toy. Productized agency with dashboard delivery.
